title: Lowo Ubukumkani Bakhe Baqubuda Phambi Kwakhe Imiqondiso
intro: Uhambo olumangalisayo lulindele abo banesibindi sokusombulula le mfihlakalo. Ngaphakathi kwiphepha leSityhilelo, kwakukho umlawuli okudibana kwakhe nomprofeti kwakuza kutshintsha isizwe sonke. Lo mntu walawula etroneni ekude, ekhokelwa zizithethe zakudala, de kwaba ngumzuzu ongaqhelekanga wenyaniso kaThixo eguqula umlawuli kunye nobukumkani ngonaphakade. Ngaba uza kuyityhila into yokuba lo mphefumlo umangalisayo obali lakhe lihlanganisa okungaqhelekanga nokunzulu?
clues: Bendilawula isizwe esichumayo ngaphesheya kwamanzi akude, sidume ngeegadi zethu kunye nebhotwe lethu elide.
Igunya lam laliphezulu, kodwa ubukumkani obukhulu buze buza kucel’ umngeni ubukho bethu kunye nobuwena bethu.
Intaka encinci yayiphethe umyalezo ongaqhelekanga, kwaye imimangaliso eyalandelayo yachitha zonke iingcamango zam ngamandla.
Ndathi ndakubona itrone iguqulwa phambi kwamehlo am, ndazi ukuba akukho mntu unokuba nobuchule obunjalo.
Ndavakalisa ngokuphandle ukuzithoba kwam kwiNkosi enye yamazulu nomhlaba, ndashiya konke endandikuthanda ngaphambili.
Thina, njengesizwe, siye sayeka ukunqula ilanga kwamandulo saza samkela inyaniso eyatshintsha yonke into.

outcome.answer: Sazithoba kuAllah saza samkela ukholo lokwenyani

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
